perf_facts_published_source_chk.name: perf_facts_published_source_chk
perf_facts_published_source_chk.value: not "catalog"."perf_facts"."published" or ("catalog"."perf_facts"."source" is not null and "catalog"."perf_facts"."fetched_at" is not null)

generated.as: case when category_code = 'ram' then specs ->> 'type' else specs ->> 'ramType' end

idea_posts_revoked_chk.name: idea_posts_revoked_chk
idea_posts_revoked_chk.value: "content"."idea_posts"."permission_status" <> 'revoked' or ("content"."idea_posts"."revoked_at" is not null and "content"."idea_posts"."takedown_due" is not null)

pages_published_uz_chk.name: pages_published_uz_chk
pages_published_uz_chk.value: "content"."pages"."status" <> 'published' or ("content"."pages"."title" ->> 'uz' <> '' and "content"."pages"."body" ->> 'uz' <> '' and "content"."pages"."published_at" is not null)

portfolio_items_own_build_chk.name: portfolio_items_own_build_chk
portfolio_items_own_build_chk.value: "content"."portfolio_items"."kind" <> 'own_build' or "content"."portfolio_items"."status" <> 'published' or ("content"."portfolio_items"."order_id" is not null and "content"."portfolio_items"."publication_consent_id" is not null)

consents_subject_chk.name: consents_subject_chk
consents_subject_chk.value: "ops"."consents"."customer_id" is not null or "ops"."consents"."subject_ref_hash" is not null

consents_order_scope_chk.name: consents_order_scope_chk
consents_order_scope_chk.value: "ops"."consents"."kind" not in ('limit_overrun', 'non_returnable', 'replacement', 'no_receipt_purchase', 'third_party_payer') or "ops"."consents"."order_id" is not null

market_prices_order_chk.name: market_prices_order_chk
market_prices_order_chk.value: "pricing"."market_prices"."min_sum" is null or "pricing"."market_prices"."max_sum" is null or "pricing"."market_prices"."min_sum" <= "pricing"."market_prices"."max_sum"

market_prices_high_chk.name: market_prices_high_chk
market_prices_high_chk.value: "pricing"."market_prices"."confidence" <> 'high' or ("pricing"."market_prices"."vendors_n" >= 5 and "pricing"."market_prices"."max_age_days" is not null and "pricing"."market_prices"."max_age_days" <= 3)

price_observations_usd_chk.name: price_observations_usd_chk
price_observations_usd_chk.value: "pricing"."price_observations"."orig_currency" <> 'USD' or ("pricing"."price_observations"."orig_amount" is not null and "pricing"."price_observations"."fx_rate_id" is not null)

acts_evidence_chk.name: acts_evidence_chk
acts_evidence_chk.value: "sales"."acts"."signed_at" is null or "sales"."acts"."evidence" is not null

payments_fee_chk.name: payments_fee_chk
payments_fee_chk.value: "sales"."payments"."kind" not in ('fee_advance', 'fee_final', 'fee_extra', 'podbor_fee') or ("sales"."payments"."direction" = 'in' and "sales"."payments"."method" in ('xolis_qr', 'merchant_card') and ("sales"."payments"."status" <> 'confirmed' or coalesce(btrim("sales"."payments"."fiscal_receipt_no"), '') <> ''))

payments_amount_chk.name: payments_amount_chk
payments_amount_chk.value: ("sales"."payments"."reversal_of" is null and "sales"."payments"."amount_sum" > 0) or ("sales"."payments"."reversal_of" is not null and "sales"."payments"."amount_sum" < 0)

payments_confirmed_chk.name: payments_confirmed_chk
payments_confirmed_chk.value: "sales"."payments"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("sales"."payments"."confirmed_at" is not null and "sales"."payments"."confirmed_by" is not null)

purchases_amount_chk.name: purchases_amount_chk
purchases_amount_chk.value: ("sales"."purchases"."refund_of" is null and "sales"."purchases"."amount_sum" > 0) or ("sales"."purchases"."refund_of" is not null and "sales"."purchases"."amount_sum" < 0)

quotes_sent_chk.name: quotes_sent_chk
quotes_sent_chk.value: "sales"."quotes"."status" not in ('sent', 'accepted') or ("sales"."quotes"."sent_at" is not null and "sales"."quotes"."manually_checked_by" is not null and "sales"."quotes"."manually_checked_at" is not null)
